meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Spain (national unitary jurisdiction; single Registro Mercantil system, no provincial company-law differentiation)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Continental European / Napoleonic heritage); codified private and commercial law (Código de Comercio 1885); corporate law codified by Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010 (Ley de Sociedades de Capital); notarial mandatory form for incorporation
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: EU–Colombia–Peru Trade Agreement (in force 2013; Ecuador acceded 2017)
EU–Central America Association Agreement (Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, Nicaragua, Costa Rica, Panama; in force since 2013)
Spain–Colombia / Spain–Peru Double Taxation Agreements in force for cross-border dividend, interest and royalty flows

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo (as amended by Ley 11/2021 and Real Decreto-ley 7/2021); Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo (Reglamento de la Ley 10/2010); Real Decreto 165/2019, de 22 de marzo (Registro de Titularidades Reales and amendment of the Registro Mercantil Regulation); Reglamento del Registro Mercantil (Real Decreto 1784/1996); transposition of Directive (EU) 2015/849 (AMLD4) and Directive (EU) 2018/843 (AMLD5).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or companies registry of the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as applicable to the origin jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney (Poder) appointing the Spanish incorporation agent and signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin, endorsed under notarial law of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization, followed by sworn translation into Spanish

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport / national identity copies of every individual UBO, director and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police or passport authority of the individual's country of nationality

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, incorporation proxies and any beneficial owners against: (i) the UN Security Council Consolidated List; (ii) the European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (European External Action Service); (iii) the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) and Non-SDN lists for all USD-denominated Swift wire and documentary letter-of-credit flows; (iv) the Spanish national designation list under Regulation (EU) No 2580/2001 and Council Decision (CFSP) 2020/1516; and (v) the FATF high-risk and monitored-jurisdictions list. Each natural person is subject to PEP classification under Article 14 Ley 10/2010 and Article 11 Real Decreto 304/2014, with enhanced due diligence (EDD) triggered by PEP status, politically exposed foreign family members, high-risk country connections, or adverse media. The target commercial profile (green coffee commodity import, documentary LC payment rails) is rated Low_Risk_Standard; standard customer due diligence (CDD), transaction monitoring, and ongoing screening apply, with EDD where any shareholder or UBO is a PEP or linked to a third-country high-risk jurisdiction.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central (RMC) — electronic 'Certificación Negativa de Denominación Social' service (https://www.rmc.es), supplementary access through the CIRCE (Centro de Información y Red de Creación de Empresas) single-window platform and the Colegio de Registradores portal.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate denomination must be rendered exclusively in Latin script; letters of any official language of the European Union are admissible but must be transliterated into Latin characters (Article 402 Reglamento del Registro Mercantil). The full incorporation instrument and all registry filings must be in Spanish; foreign-language documents require sworn translation (traducción jurada) by a translator accredited by the Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The chosen denomination must be followed by the legal-form suffix 'Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada' or the abbreviation 'S.L.' (equally acceptable: 'S.R.L.'), and the suffix must appear in every commercial document.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: 'España', 'Estado', 'Nacional', 'Real', 'Agencia', 'Ministerio', 'Gobierno' — terms suggesting official or public-body status, requiring prior authorization by the Ministry of Justice and/or the respective administration

'Banco', 'Caja', 'Caja de Ahorros', 'Seguros', 'Reaseguro', 'Mutualidad de Previsión Social' — reserved for financial and insurance entities, requiring prior ministerial authorization of the Minister of Economy and the Director General de Seguros
'Fundación' — reserved for foundations, requiring prior classification by the competent Protectorado de Fundaciones
'Cámara Oficial', 'Cámara de Comercio', 'Cruz Roja', 'Federación de...', 'Confederación de...' — protected names of public-law corporations and recognized institutions
'Internacional', 'Mundial', 'Iberoamericano', 'Andino', 'Europeo' — only permitted where the corporate purpose genuinely involves cross-border or international activity, subject to RMC discretion

Geographical names of Spanish regions, provinces, municipalities, or sub-state entities (e.g., 'Andalucía', 'Madrid') — only permissible where the company has a demonstrable establishment in the place or the competent administration issues a non-misleading certificate

Names identical or confusingly similar to an existing company denomination, a registered EU trade mark (EUTM), or a Spanish trade mark, as checked by the RMC against its name database and trademark indexes
Words or expressions contrary to law, public order, or good customs
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The RMC negative-denomination certificate is valid for three months from its date of issue. If the incorporation deed is not executed within that period, a new certificate must be solicited; no automatic extension applies. Upon rejection (denegación) of a requested name due to coincidence, confusing similarity, trademark conflict, or use of a prohibited term, the applicant may: (i) submit a fresh application enclosing up to three alternative proposed denominations in a single filing; (ii) file a written administrative reclamation with the RMC Registrador within fifteen working days of the notification, asserting distinctiveness and attaching supporting evidence (e.g., trademark coexistence consent); and (iii) if the reclamation is dismissed, appeal to the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública (DGSJFP) of the Spanish Ministry of Justice within one month of the rejection notice. The DGSJFP decision is final in administrative law and may be challenged before the National Court (Audiencia Nacional). During the pendency of an appeal, the applicant may not use the contested denomination for incorporation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partially permissible with structural caveats. Article 9 of the Ley de Sociedades de Capital requires a physically existing Spanish address where management and administration are actually located or where the principal activity is carried out; a letter-box-only or non-existent 'virtual office' does not satisfy the statute. In commercial practice, a lawfully operated 'domiciliación mercantil' service — a physical Spanish address with mail reception, record-keeping capacity, and human attendance — is accepted by the Registro Mercantil and AEAT for an import-based SL, provided the service provider has a genuine physical presence. For the specialty green coffee container import model, a professional domiciliation address combined with a customs broker's operational facility is commercially adequate at incorporation, but AEAT may require the registered address to reflect actual management substance if VAT, customs, or documentary inconsistencies arise.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-Low: approximately 10–15% cumulative probability of an unannounced physical verification visit within the first 36 months of operation. AEAT performs targeted 'visitas de comprobación' on a small percentage of newly VAT-registered companies, and municipal business-census inspections occur sporadically. The likelihood rises if intrastat filings, customs entries, or IVA (VAT) claims show anomalies; documentary customs audits by Aduanas are more frequent (estimated 8–12% of first-year importers) than on-site premises inspections.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RMC corporate name clearance certificate (Certificación Negativa de Denominación Social) — one primary name plus up to three alternatives
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff — RMC fee schedule per Orden JUS/318/2018 (approximately EUR 15.30 for the first name and a modest per-alternative surcharge)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial deed of incorporation (escritura de constitución), including verification of minimum share capital subscription (EUR 3,000 under Article 4 Ley de Sociedades de Capital) and inclusion of all UBO identification data
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Spanish notary (Notario) having territorial competence over the registered office, acting under the Colegio Notarial
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff (Real Decreto 1426/1989), calculated on the arancel notarial base for a EUR 3,000 share capital plus statutory annexes and deed copies; prevailing market benchmark EUR 450–650

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mercantile Registry inscription fee (inscripción de la sociedad en el Registro Mercantil Provincial)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province where the registered office is located
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff per Real Decreto 1427/1989; typical benchmark EUR 80–120 for an SL of minimum capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: NIE (Número de Identidad de Extranjero) application per non-resident director/shareholder/UBO — administrative fee plus consular processing where applicable
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Oficina de Extranjería (Ministry of Inclusion, Social Security and Migration) or competent Spanish Consulate in the country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory administrative fee (Tasa 790-012, approximately EUR 10.80 per applicant); consular surcharges may apply in some jurisdictions

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille and/or consular legalization of origin-country UBO and corporate shareholder documents (average of two document sets; USD 5–60 per apostille depending on origin authority)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority of the document origin state (e.g., Secretary of State, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, or designated court) or the Spanish Embassy/Consulate in non-Hague states
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fee set by the origin competent authority under the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention or by the Spanish consular service; plus international courier costs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn translation into Spanish (traducción jurada) of the incorporation deed annexes, apostilled origin documents, and corporate shareholder instruments — estimated 2–3 pages
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Traductor Jurado registered with the Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MAEC) or accredited bilingual notary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark USD 80–150 per standard page; total depends on document volume and language pairs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Filings with the Registro de Titularidades Reales (UBO register) and SEPBLAC — submission of beneficial ownership declaration within the statutory deadline
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Mercantil / SEPBLAC (Servicio Ejecutivo de la Comisión de Prevención del Blanqueo de Capitales) via the RTR portal; agent handling fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing is free of charge; gestoría or compliance-agent administrative fee benchmark USD 40–60

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Digital certificate (certificado digital) for company access to AEAT, Aduanas, Registro Mercantil, and SSF portals — one certificate for the legal representative
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: FNMT-RCM (Fábrica Nacional de Moneda y Timbre) / Dirección General de la Policía
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory issuance fee approximately EUR 25–35; no annual charge on the FNMT standard certificate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered-office domiciliation service (domiciliación mercantil) — professional physical address with mail reception, calendar, and records custody — pro-rated six months for pre-incorporation and initial operation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed domiciliation service provider (third-party commercial office)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate USD 350–600 per full year; pro-rated USD 175–300 for six months

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate counsel pre-incorporation due diligence and AML/CFT compliance pack — UBO piercing analysis, sanctions/PEP screening, name-search supervision, deed review, and NIE/UBO filing coordination
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Bar-admitted Spanish corporate attorney (abogado) or colegiada gestoría administrativa
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fixed fee USD 900–1,500 for a fully documented Stage-1 compliance pack inclusive of all screening reports

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank pre-incorporation KYC/AML account opening for the 'sociedad en formación' (in-formation company) — documentation drafting and identity verification; no bank fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Spanish credit institution (e.g., Santander, BBVA, CaixaBank) acting under its AML/CFT onboarding obligations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory or bank charge; document preparation absorbed within the corporate counsel fixed fee

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 5/2015 de Sociedades de Capital (Law on Capital Companies), as amended, particularly articles 1-4 (company types) and articles 5-10 (formation and governance of Sociedad Limitada)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escribano Público - Escritura de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum subscribed and paid-up capital of 3,000 EUR for Sociedad Limitada; fully paid prior to business commencement; no escrow account required; capital deposited directly into corporate bank account
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The First Board of Directors of the Company, a Sociedad Limitada under Spanish law, unanimously resolves as follows: (1) To subscribe to the entire share capital of the Company as set forth in the Articles of Association, with the initial share capital amounting to three thousand euros (EUR 3,000); (2) To adopt the registered office at [Insert full address], Spain, for the purposes of all official communications and filings; (3) To appoint [Insert name of managing director] as the sole administrator and legal representative of the Company, with full powers to bind the Company in all acts of administration and disposition; (4) To authorize the opening of a corporate bank account at [Bank name] and to appoint signatories; and (5) To confirm that all statutory formalities for incorporation have been complied with. This resolution is adopted in accordance with the provisions of the Articles of Association and the Ley de Sociedades de Capital. The Board directs the administrator to proceed with all necessary registrations and filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Submission of Incorporation Documents to the Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Sede Electrónica del Registro Mercantil (Electronic Registry Office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the public deed of incorporation before a Spanish Notary Public (Escribano Público). Submit the executed deed electronically via the Registro Mercantil portal together with the articles of association, proof of share capital subscription and payment, shareholder and administrator identification documents, proof of registered office, and tax identification number. Pay applicable fees online.
required_dossiers: Proof of share capital subscription and payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or rejected, the applicant may submit additional documentation or request a procedural extension within the statutory period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for wholesale coffee bean distribution and import activities
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No specific industrial or manufacturing permit required

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Agencia Española de Seguridad Alimentaria y Nutrición (AESAN)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with EU and Spanish food safety and import regulations; no manufacturing, processing, wastewater, or VOC emissions generated by distribution activities

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification and workplace safety inspection may be required for storage or distribution facilities; not mandatory for incorporation but required prior to operations

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), official portal https://www.aeat.es/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Spanish SL entities obtain NIF through AEAT registration by submitting incorporation documents, ID proofs, and address details via the online portal or in-person. Foreign-owned SLs follow similar process with tax representative if non-resident. NIF serves as TIN and VAT ID.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box; Spain applies entity-level taxation for resident companies. Hybrid mismatch elections limited to EU directives compliance.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory factura electrónica for most transactions; SII (Immediate Information System) for real-time reporting and digital stamping for VAT-registered entities.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT on export of goods outside EU; requires proof of actual export and non-EU destination. Services to non-EU clients qualify under reverse charge or zero-rating rules.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Clawback of zero-rated VAT if export not proven; penalties up to 100% of VAT due plus interest; criminal sanctions for intentional fraud.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain operates within the Eurozone with full capital account convertibility and current account convertibility under EU law. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders face no FX restrictions beyond standard corporate tax filings and beneficial ownership verification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Foreign currency export receipts must be converted to euros within one year of receipt or shipment date per Bank of Spain guidelines and Royal Decree 671/2012. Mandatory surrender to authorized Spanish banks with supporting commercial documentation required for compliance.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasible via regulated platforms such as Revolut Business or N26 Corporate under Spanish AML framework; legal constraints include mandatory AEAT reporting, KYC/AML screening, and restrictions on offshore digital EMIs exceeding transaction thresholds.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote digital onboarding permitted for Spanish SL entities using electronic ID verification (DNIe or equivalent) and video KYC; physical appearance required only for initial incorporation or transactions above €100,000.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained source of funds for import payments
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial invoices, purchase orders, shipping documents, supplier contracts, and proof of payment to foreign counterparties

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: SWIFT MT103 wires with purpose code 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION' or 'EQUITY INJECTION'; verification requires shareholder resolutions, ownership certificates, and bank statements. All inbound transactions screened against Spanish AML directives with reference to CIF/NIF.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: SWIFT MT103 for trade settlements and Commercial Letters of Credit via correspondent banks; mandatory purpose codes such as 'GOODS PURCHASE' and full documentation package for Spanish and EU AML compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1-25 July following the close of the 31 December fiscal year (within 25 days after the six-month period following year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 5% - 20%, annual late interest, and penalties up to 150% of the tax due for non-wilful omissions; no administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts deposit (depósito de cuentas anuales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month of shareholders' approval; approval must occur within six months of the year-end (for calendar-year companies: by 31 July)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Blocking of all subsequent Commercial Registry filings and administrative fine of EUR 1,200 - 60,000 imposed by the ICAC; no strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 February - 31 March of the year following the calendar year; must be filed when annual transactions with any single counterparty exceed EUR 3,005.06
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties of EUR 20 per omitted item and up to EUR 75,000 for fraudulent omissions; no strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1-30 January following the calendar year for companies registered for Spanish VAT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 1% per month up to 20% plus late interest; serious non-compliance can trigger suspension of VAT deduction rights.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Legalisation and sealing of mandatory corporate and accounting books
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Before 30 April of the year following the fiscal year-end (within four months of the annual close)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-legalised books lose evidential value; annual accounts deposit is blocked; ICAC penalty up to EUR 60,000 may be imposed.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for an SL when, for two consecutive years, the company meets at least two of the following criteria: total assets exceed EUR 2,850,000; annual net turnover exceeds EUR 5,700,000; average number of employees exceeds 50. Also mandatory for listed companies, credit entities, and certain public-interest groups.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (Plan General de Contabilidad) under the Commercial Code and Capital Companies Act; consolidated group accounts within an EU-based group prepared under IFRS-EU; individual accounts prepared under Spanish GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate annual UBO return is required for an ordinary SL; however, under Law 10/2010 and Royal Decree-Law 7/2021, the company must continuously maintain accurate beneficial-ownership information. Any transfer of shares must be formalised by public deed, entered in the Shareholders' Register, and, when the UBO changes, reflected in the Commercial Registry and relevant tax disclosures. The annual accounts filing serves as the periodic statutory confirmation point.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors (Libro Registro de Administradores)
Accounting books (Libro de Inventarios y Cuentas Anuales; Libro Diario)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 - USD 900 per year for a registered office / corporate agent service in Madrid, Barcelona, or Valencia
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,200 - USD 6,500 for a statutory audit when required; if audit thresholds are not exceeded, no statutory audit fee is incurred
